_comment: Every navigation-relevant number the engine uses — Aneesh/SIH-IDR-android.md §10: 'No numeric constant relevant to navigation appears in Kotlin source.' See EngineConfig.kt for what each field means and where the value came from.
_comment_handling: ZUPT is a floor test only — shaking the phone exceeds its thresholds and disables it. HandlingDetector is the missing ceiling: mean gyro rate PERPENDICULAR to gravity, which a vehicle body cannot sustain and a hand cannot avoid. 0.44 rad/s = 25 deg/s, argued from vehicle physics and not yet fitted — telemetry logs tilt_rate_rps every tick so a real drive can replace it. See TODO.md G1.
_comment_handling_gate: MEASURE-ONLY for the first vehicle drive (TODO.md H9). The gate has never seen a car, and a false positive holds speed and freezes heading — which would corrupt the drive it is meant to be calibrated against. tilt_rate_rps and handling are still logged every tick. Turn on once a drive shows the distribution, same as use_gnss_nis_gate and use_map_match_fusion.
_comment_delta: OFF. FeatureExtractor emits a_horiz as a MAGNITUDE, so the sign of longitudinal acceleration is gone before the delta model sees it — accelerating and braking are the same input. Verified: a hard-braking window returns +0.30 m/s^2 where truth is -2.5. Field: +0.01 m/s^2 regardless of what the vehicle did. Needs a signed longitudinal channel and a retrain, not a config change. TODO K2.
_comment_tick_dt: The engine integrates REAL elapsed time, not a nominal 1/rate. Measured tick spacing was p50 99ms / p90 212ms / p99 647ms, so the fixed dt lost 20.5% of elapsed time and was masking the speed model error. This bounds how much a single late tick may integrate. TODO K1.
_comment_gnss_gate: Escalating acceptance, not a binary gate. Strict 30 m while fixes flow; after gnss_starved_after_s with nothing accepted, fixes up to the ceiling pass through with their real accuracy. The old hardcoded binary 30 m gate locked GNSS out for 2h11m of an indoor session (9 sats in view, every fix >30 m) while the engine dead-reckoned 1.4 km of drift.
